ambiguities.aspect: Bit ordering / MSB vs LSB of the 25-bit output vector
readings: out is declared as [24:0] (out[24] is the MSB), so out[24] = ~a^a is the leftmost bit and out[0] = ~e^e is the rightmost bit
out is declared as [0:24] (out[24] is the LSB), so out[24] = ~a^a is the rightmost bit and out[0] = ~e^e is the leftmost bit, reversing the physical pin order of the comparisons
